title: atoll notify test --json
description: A test alert through each alert channel the configuration sets, then a request that changes nothing to each media server it sets, which the server's token or key must open, and whether each went (specs.md §21.5, §23, §25). Exit 0 when each went, 4 when one did not.

channels.description: The alert channels set, in the order of specs.md §23, then the media servers set, in the order of specs.md §21.5; never empty, as with none set the command exits with 1 and prints nothing.

channel.description: The configuration key that sets the channel, or the table that sets the media server.

sent.description: Whether the server took the alert, or answered the request: a 2xx answer.

error.description: Why it did not go, for a reader: present only when sent is false, and worded freely.
